source_review: Only closure difference is placement of Narrow/Broad/BroadTree in the snapshot Error enum; current bytes equal main. Error has no numeric repr or Serialize derive and this patch adds no ordinal serialization/cast; named variants and Display Debug diagnostics preserve semantics.

Private native Arena/Coarena/Graph/body/collider staging, allocation charging, primitive shape restrictions and exact borrowed frame joins retain accepted producer bytes. Public NumericFrame still only admits numerical input; no live constructor or installer is exposed.
Default-off incant-checked-restore and incant-checkpoint dependency edges/manifests are unchanged from main and producer. No root dependency/lock growth.

Native private test prepare helper retains original source-copy/path-only substitution and root-lock seeding; current-main tests still need exact selected solver feature and copied-lock relevance checks.

Documentation distinguishes private field continuation using trusted remaining-owner clones from complete world construction/save admission; OOM behavior, allocation-request vs RSS, phase/ownership/generation limitations remain explicit.
limits: Current-main CPU qualification has not run at this source review; producer test claims are retained historical evidence, not new execution.
No live save admission, authenticated restore, phone/performance/appearance or complete-world gate is approved.
